scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../storage && npm run build && cd ../router && npm run build && cd ../shared && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../hashline && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build && cd ../../apps/server && npm run build && cd ../dashboard && npm run build && cd ../chat && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run dev:clean-ports && npm run dev:start
scripts.dev:start: concurrently --names "ai,storage,router,shared,agent,coding-agent,server,dashboard,chat,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,gray,blue,magenta,yellow,red,white,black,green,blueBright" "cd packages/ai && npm run dev" "cd packages/storage && npm run dev" "cd packages/router && npm run dev" "cd packages/shared && npm run dev" "cd packages/agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/coding-agent && npm run dev" "cd apps/server && npm run dev" "cd apps/dashboard && npm run dev" "cd apps/chat && npm run dev" "cd packages/tui && npm run dev"
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --package-lock=false && node scripts/sync-versions.js && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --package-lock=false && node scripts/sync-versions.js && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --package-lock=false && node scripts/sync-versions.js && shx rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish --workspace @pie-lab/ai --workspace @pie-lab/tui --workspace @pie-lab/router --workspace @pie-lab/storage --workspace @pie-lab/shared --workspace @pie-lab/agent-core --workspace @pie-lab/hashline --workspace @pie-lab/coding-agent --access public
scripts.publish:dry: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish --workspace @pie-lab/ai --workspace @pie-lab/tui --workspace @pie-lab/router --workspace @pie-lab/storage --workspace @pie-lab/shared --workspace @pie-lab/agent-core --workspace @pie-lab/hashline --workspace @pie-lab/coding-agent --access public --dry-run
